candidate_framing: LSEG/Gemma semantic event selection with FinBERT cross-sectional ranking and liquidity-aware implementation
purpose: Test one analytically derived within-leg allocation intended to reduce Notebook 51's square-root impact cost without changing event dates, selected names, signs, leg budgets, horizon, or sentiment inputs.

motivation_boundary.opened_evidence: Notebook 51 estimated an optimistic USD 10m capacity bound and found the first USD 25m participation breaches concentrated in DUK and PLD.
motivation_boundary.forbidden_inference: The result cannot validate alpha, select a sentiment rule, delete observed losing names, or replace the prospective new-date gate.

base_strategy.event_schedule: Gemma exact-extreme firm-open event counts and eligible sessions
base_strategy.ranking: FinBERT strongest_event cross-sectional rank with symbol-ascending stable tie-break

liquidity_inputs.adv_usd: per-symbol 20-session rolling mean of close times volume, minimum five observations, shifted one complete session
liquidity_inputs.volatility: per-symbol 20-session rolling sample standard deviation of open-to-open returns, minimum five observations, shifted one complete session
liquidity_inputs.missing_policy: fail closed for every selected name

allocation_rule.objective_from_flat: For each leg, minimise sum_i (sigma_i / sqrt(ADV_i)) * weight_i^(3/2).
allocation_rule.closed_form_before_caps: weight_i proportional to ADV_i / max(sigma_i, volatility_floor)^2
allocation_rule.cap_solution: Deterministic iterative water filling: cap weights above 0.25, remove their budget, and redistribute the remainder in the same priority proportions until the original leg budget is exhausted.
allocation_rule.long_and_short_legs: solved independently with non-negative magnitudes, then short weights receive a negative sign
allocation_rule.unused_capacity: No new name is introduced. If the selected names cannot support the original leg budget under the existing 25% cap, fail closed rather than change exposure.

input_only_gate.flat_entry_impact_proxy: strictly lower in aggregate than equal weighting
input_only_gate.stop_rule: If any condition fails, do not construct or inspect the modified strategy's forward returns. Record an input-only NO-GO.

comparators: same-AUM equal-weight Notebook 36 hybrid under identical fixed and impact costs
same targets under Y=0 as a decomposition of allocation-return changes from impact savings
outcome_evaluation_if_input_gate_passes.paired_family: Two liquidity-aware-minus-equal net-return comparisons, one at USD 10m and one at USD 25m; 9,999 five-session circular-block bootstrap replications; BH-FDR q=0.05.
outcome_evaluation_if_input_gate_passes.temporal_check: Report primary USD 10m net Sharpe and total return in both chronological halves.
outcome_evaluation_if_input_gate_passes.primary_implementation_gate: At USD 10m, positive total net return and net Sharpe, lower realised impact cost per traded dollar, and a positive paired mean difference with BH q<0.05.
outcome_evaluation_if_input_gate_passes.capacity_extension_gate: At USD 25m, positive total net return and net Sharpe, every order at or below 5% lagged full-day ADV, and a positive paired mean difference with BH q<0.05.

limitations: The objective is exact only for trades from flat; drifted rebalances are evaluated rather than optimised.
The opened LSEG return window motivated this diagnostic.
Full-day ADV is optimistic for opening-auction execution.
The square-root impact coefficient is a scenario, not an estimate from this corpus.
A passing implementation gate cannot establish or promote alpha.
